Design Notes — Identity Lock

  • Long BLACK hair + silver streak, pale skin — NOT a blue face or red nose.
  • Red eyes; great BLACK raven wings.
  • Black kimono, gold clouds; folding fan — not a staff.
  • Red mask with GOLD HORNS and fangs hung at the hip — horned and fanged, never long-nosed; full moon. Keep the reference's soft dreamy glow, bloom and painterly finish — never flat studio.
  • Pure Edo fantasy; no modern tech.
